# ======================================== # Ctrl-Pay Development Environment Configuration # Used for local development with local MySQL # ========================================
# Database Configuration (Local MySQL) spring.datasource.url=jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/ctrl_pay?serverTimezone=UTC&useSSL=false&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true spring.datasource.username=root spring.datasource.password=admin123 spring.datasource.driver-class-name=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
# Connection Pool Settings (Dev - smaller pool) spring.datasource.hikari.maximum-pool-size=5 spring.datasource.hikari.minimum-idle=1
# Schema Initialization (Dev - always init) spring.sql.init.mode=always spring.sql.init.platform=mysql spring.sql.init.data-locations=classpath:schema.sql
# Logging for Development (Very Verbose) logging.level.root=INFO logging.level.com.neueda=DEBUG logging.level.org.springframework.jdbc=DEBUG logging.level.org.springframework.jdbc.core=DEBUG logging.level.org.springframework.web=DEBUG logging.level.org.springframework=INFO
# Display formatted SQL spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.format_sql=true
# Actuator (All endpoints visible in dev) management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,metrics,prometheus management.endpoint.health.show-details=always
# Server Configuration (Dev) server.error.include-message=always server.error.include-binding-errors=always server.error.include-stacktrace=always server.error.include-exception=true
# Jackson Configuration spring.jackson.serialization.write-dates-as-timestamps=false spring.jackson.serialization.indent-output=true spring.jackson.time-zone=UTC spring.jackson.default-property-inclusion=non_null

# ======================================== # Ctrl-Pay Docker Environment Configuration # Used when running via docker-compose # ========================================
# Database Configuration (MySQL Service via docker-compose) spring.datasource.url=jdbc:mysql://mysql:3306/ctrl_pay?serverTimezone=UTC&useSSL=false&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true spring.datasource.username=${SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME:root} spring.datasource.password=${SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD:admin123}
# Logging for Docker (less verbose) logging.level.root=INFO logging.level.com.neueda=INFO logging.level.org.springframework.jdbc=INFO logging.level.org.springframework=WARN
# Actuator (accessible in Docker) management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,metrics management.endpoint.health.show-details=always

option.name: updatedContent
option.value:
# ======================================== # Ctrl-Pay Application Configuration # ========================================
# Application Metadata spring.application.name=ctrl_pay app.name=Ctrl-Pay app.version=@project.version@ app.description=Payment Processing System REST API
# ======================================== # Database Configuration (Default: Development with Local MySQL) # ========================================
# Database Connection spring.datasource.url=jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/ctrl_pay?serverTimezone=UTC&useSSL=false&allowPublicKeyRetrieval=true spring.datasource.username=root spring.datasource.password=admin123 spring.datasource.driver-class-name=com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver
# Connection Pool Settings spring.datasource.hikari.maximum-pool-size=10 spring.datasource.hikari.minimum-idle=2 spring.datasource.hikari.idle-timeout=600000 spring.datasource.hikari.max-lifetime=1800000 spring.datasource.hikari.connection-timeout=20000
# Schema Initialization spring.sql.init.mode=always spring.sql.init.platform=mysql spring.sql.init.data-locations=classpath:schema.sql
# JPA/Hibernate (minimal config for JDBC usage) spring.jpa.show-sql=false spring.jpa.properties.hibernate.dialect=org.hibernate.dialect.MySQL8Dialect
# ======================================== # Server Configuration # ========================================
server.port=8080 server.servlet.context-path=/ server.error.include-message=always server.error.include-binding-errors=always server.error.include-stacktrace=on-param server.error.include-exception=false
# ======================================== # Logging Configuration # ========================================
# Root Logger logging.level.root=INFO
# Application Logging logging.level.com.neueda=DEBUG
# SQL Logging (for debugging queries) logging.level.org.springframework.jdbc=DEBUG logging.level.org.springframework.jdbc.core=DEBUG
# Reduce noise from Spring framework logging.level.org.springframework=WARN logging.level.org.springframework.boot=INFO logging.level.org.springframework.web=INFO logging.level.org.springframework.security=WARN
# ======================================== # Spring Boot Actuator Configuration # ========================================
# Enable actuator endpoints management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,metrics,prometheus management.endpoints.web.base-path=/actuator management.endpoint.health.show-details=when-authorized management.health.livenessState.enabled=true management.health.readinessState.enabled=true
# ======================================== # Jackson Configuration (JSON Processing) # ========================================
# Date/Time formatting spring.jackson.serialization.write-dates-as-timestamps=false spring.jackson.time-zone=UTC spring.jackson.default-property-inclusion=non_null
# ======================================== # Profile-Specific Configuration # ======================================== # This file is the DEFAULT profile # Use -Dspring.profiles.active=dev|docker|prod to switch profiles # application-dev.properties -> Development (local MySQL) # application-docker.properties -> Docker Compose (MySQL via service name) # application-prod.properties -> Production (external MySQL host)
